source.test_name: native question reads the same-case public CAPEX answer without confirming pending training and reopens its real thread consumer

purpose: A real human-selected CAPEX conversation supplies an unconfirmed answer relevant to the same pending training condition. The question follows that actual answer; it does not turn the conversation into confirmed cost evidence.
same_case_chain: Actual Planner 2027 source and one real C09/C10 alternative preserve 96 observed components for the eight non-training categories (12 months each), known subtotal 210000, conditioned comparison and null full total.
Actual public current-year Project and CAPEX2027 scalar-name record selections enter one confirmed pmo-capex relation, with the Planner evidence, and the same real case.

A real review thread on exactly the CAPEX2027 record receives a human reply through C06. The actual sf_answer_read port must return its real thread ID, one exact CAPEX evidence ref and state unconfirmed.

A human baseline-coverage classification names that real thread as questionRef on the still-pending training entry; actual decision-promote preserves it. No stored case, result, choice, receipt or contribution is seeded.
The real QuestionPlanningInput carries the same case/condition/thread/relation and authorized recipient. Its condition evidenceRefs remain empty.

The human mission explicitly selects only that same CAPEX record as the conversation context; the QuestionProposal subset is allowed by the closed verifier and remains inside the case/relation. No private handle or authority is inserted.

consumer_boundaries.without_model: Actual UI sf_question_prepare receipt -> canonical human question-consume -> idempotent retry -> human reply -> independent host reload -> actual thread and unconfirmed answer reader. This is UI proof only.
consumer_boundaries.with_model: Actual native Session/SkillLoadReceipt and completed tool receipts -> C11 QuestionProposal -> reloaded C11 reader -> human question-consume -> actual reply -> independent third host -> canonical thread/answer reader. No UI proposal substitutes for the native output.
consumer_boundaries.period: Consumer source and thread periods both equal the public CAPEX2027 period, which lies inside the same case2027 horizon. The current-year Project source remains relation context, never the selected thread source.
consumer_boundaries.reply_state: Unconfirmed reply never resolves coverage, confirms a price, adds training components, changes the case or applies the domain.
consumer_boundaries.source_withdrawal: After positive consumers, remove only the selected CAPEX raw record. Both predecessor and consumed-thread answer/HTTP reads must refuse; the homonymous other CAPEX source remains readable. A real native output is reauthorized and must refuse regardless of current model availability.

native_audit: Only actual completed Session tool-call IDs already tied by the harness to run/session/principal/SkillLoadReceipt are accepted.

For every witnessed completed call, the real receipt must bind operation, callId, run, native session and principal; its inputDigest and resultDigest must equal the actual persisted tool input and structured result. The case and predecessor inputs are exact; the question input is reconstructed from the real typed output. No ordering is imposed on relation recordRefs.
The real sf_answer_read result must match the predecessor, answer text, unconfirmed state and exact CAPEX ref.
ASC Session messages require that answer result in an earlier assistant message than the completed sf_question_prepare matching the native payload.
C11 consumer takes the actual native outputRef/outputDigest/run provenance, then reopens the same canonical thread.
negatives: Homonymous CAPEX source outside the case is refused by sf_question_prepare as denied/source-access-unavailable, without a new thread.
Unadmitted HTTP cannot read the actual predecessor thread or reveal its answer.
Selected source withdrawal refuses both real answer lineages and HTTP consumers while the other homonymous source remains readable.
Any completed native output remains subject to the current source fence even if models later disappear.

scope_limits.pending_origin: explicit human classification, not derived omitted-category proof
